verseText: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.”
meaning: When we believe in Jesus, we have a promise from him. After we die, we'll live forever with him. When he returns, our bodies will be raised to life.

recall.question: Jesus calls Himself the resurrection and the life. What does resurrection mean?

meaning.question: What does Jesus mean when He says believers will live even though they die?
choices: They will be raised to live with Him forever
They will come back as babies

application.prompt: Death can feel scary or make us very sad, especially when someone we love dies. But Jesus has power over death! He promises that everyone who believes in Him will live with Him forever. When you feel sad or afraid about death, remember the wonderful hope Jesus gives us!
